card.name: Digit that starts a count or multiple
card.fires_on: A leading digit just after an opening parenthesis or 'of' that begins a quantity, such as '300 mg' or '2 tablets', where a multiplier-style reading ('times', '×') could follow. It appears mostly in dose breakdowns and also in totals like '30 lb'.

modes.label: Dose breakdown in parentheses
modes.description: First digit of a dose or tablet count inside brackets that restates the total dose.

modes.label: Count of units
modes.description: A digit giving the number of tablets, syringes or items making up a dose.

modes.label: Non-drug totals
modes.description: A number in a calculation or a count of equipment, outside drug labels.
